sources.title: Reviewer independent CPU recomputation of raw OCR
Order/denominator/information-loss derivation
sources.details: Counter(牛奶\n麵包) = Counter(麵包\n牛奶), but sequences differ. Exact-match requires equality under the predeclared representation. len(empty reference)=0, so distance/0 is undefined; a separate presence task can retain false positives. Levenshtein unit operations are reversible, so prediction-to-reference distance agrees with reference-to-prediction; all ratios use reference length. More extras than reference length gives a ratio greater than one. A many-to-one finite pixel reduction cannot have a universal inverse; enlargement may interpolate, but cannot guarantee the true missing strokes. A flat GT string with no region-order schema cannot prove all layout relationships. Success on 18 fixed synthetic strings entails only those observations, not universal Chinese OCR.
